routes.label: Apply the discount before the tax

question: A dress originally priced at \(\$80\) was put on sale at \(25\%\) off. If \(10\%\) tax was added to the sale price, then the total selling price of the dress was
solution:
The tax is based on the sale price, so first find the price after the discount. The \(25\%\) discount is
\[
0.25\cdot80=20
\]
dollars, leaving a sale price of \(80-20=60\) dollars. The tax is then \(10\%\) of \(60\), which is \(0.10\cdot60=6\) dollars. Thus the total selling price is
\[
60+6=66
\]
dollars, or \(\$66\), choice D.
